args: s=$1; shift; d=$PWD; until [ -f "$d/$s" ] || [ "$d" = / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/$s" ] || { echo "mcp-launcher: no $s in $PWD or any parent folder" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash "$d/$s" "$@"
